title: Quality assessment and grading of onions are often subjective and vary across procurement centers, resulting in disputes and inconsistencies.
organization: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
description: Expected Solution: Develop an AI-based mobile application that:• Uses image processing to assess onion quality.• Identifies damaged, rotten, sprouted, or undersized onions.• Estimates Grade A and URS percentages.• Generates a digital quality report instantly.• Reduces human bias and improves transparency.
